scope: Implemented bounded IEEE1588-2008 default multicast E2E two-step fixed-body encoding, association, measurement and conditional BMCA dataset comparison, plus its local evidence/input policies.

certification: No IEEE certification or full-protocol conformance is asserted.

review_findings.finding: Shorter stepsRemoved wins. longer.receiver > longer.sender means topology=true. Both orderings and error1 equality appear in separately compiled LinuxPTP vectors. Independently rendered and visually reviewed Garner tutorial p62 corroborates all same-GM branches; it remains a non-normative official-hosted tutorial.

Official interpretation directly confirms Follow_Up=FALSE. The implementation also requires FALSE for Delay_Req/Delay_Resp/Announce; full Table20 applicability must be verified before promoting this to fully clause-reviewed.
0/1/2/3/5 and common offsets match independent fixtures/TShark and LinuxPTP layouts. Complete normative control enumeration remains to be reviewed.
INT64_MAX and -1 are excluded as Unsupported, not Violation. Public interpretation responses conflict; no unique sentinel resolution is asserted.

Associations use equality of domain/source/sequence and requester fields. No numeric sequence ordering crosses rollover. Epoch/window are supplied capture context; Delay_Req target master is an explicit claim.

Remaining semantic enumerations, all message-specific flag/reserved-field conditions, sender initialization fields and logMessageInterval values are not exhaustively validated. WIRE.FIXED_BODY means only implemented checks passed.
